description: Ministry of Industrial Export and Investment Promotion - Reserved - Amendment to the Sri Lanka Export Development Act
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an Order issued under Section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It amends previous gazette notifications to add specific provisions related to health protection equipment and medical supplies during the COVID-19 pandemic. While it mentions Minister Prasanna Ranatunga, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory in nature, establishing legal provisions for customs exemptions and import regulations.
